svg.text: Data never moves between environments. Each has its own database, keys and address.
Every environment runs a version the enterprise approved. Content moves only through the org repo.
ENVIRONMENTS · AWS OR AZURE · EXCLUDES AI USAGE

With a 1-year commitment, about $1,250 a month. DEV and UAT can be smaller (4 vCPU · 16 GB) or stopped out of hours.
